conviction_note: The public 月次 (Q2 existing-store about -4%, June -10.7% on the payback from Q1's Middle-East stockpiling) set against the Q1 cushion (OP 117.3% of the Q1 plan) put H1 OP about 3.5% above the company's own H1 plan (range -0.5% to +8%), with Q2 standalone OP down about 5-20% YoY. Every input is public and the stock has already recovered from 1,479 to 1,589 since the post-Q1 fade. DCM's close-to-close reactions have faded 5 of 7 prints, and even the +17%-vs-plan Q1 beat gave back its whole +4.4% within two sessions. So the reaction is sized at +0.3, below the +0.5 finding and far below the fact.

findings.finding: The Q1 over-delivery (OP ¥11.37bn against an implied Q1 plan of ~¥9.70bn, +¥1.68bn) exceeds the likely Q2 shortfall implied by the published 月次 (Q2 existing-store -10.7/-1.8/-0.2, all-store -5.4/+4.3/+6.0). So H1 OP most likely lands around ¥20.5-21.5bn against the ¥20.2bn plan (H1 経常 ~¥19.9bn against ¥19.3bn, roughly flat YoY), a 'plan beaten' H1 print carrying a Q2 standalone OP decline of about 5-20% YoY.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Actual close-to-next-close reactions from Yahoo bars on the kabutan-listed release dates: H1 FY26 (2025-09-26, OP 94.7% of plan) -0.96%; Q1 FY27 (2026-06-26, OP 117.3% of plan) +4.44%, fully reversed by 2026-07-01 (1,575 to 1,484); FY26 (2026-04-14) -4.46%; others -2.05, -3.17, -1.99, +1.43. 5 of 7 negative at the close, though 5 of 7 opened higher. Beats get bought at the open and sold into the session.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-08 (page 最終更新日; August 2026 速報)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly it is priced, and that is why the size is small. The 月次 are syndicated (ryutsuu 2026-09-14) and the 117.3%-of-plan Q1 figure is in the Q1 supplement. If the market feared an H1 miss after June's -10.7%, the stock would sit near the 1,480 post-June-monthly level. It trades at 1,589, back near its post-Q1 high. The unpriced residue is only the size of the cushion: few readers do the Q1-plan against Q2-shortfall arithmetic on a thinly covered name, and Q2's Enchō drag (about -¥0.8bn a quarter in Q1, and not in last year's Q2 base) is the swing item.
findings.independence: The progress-rate arithmetic comes from a different document: the Q1 supplement https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260626/140120260626581136.pdf (plan ratios, Enchō -793 OP bridge) and last year's H1 supplement https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20250926/140120250926563086.pdf (Q2 FY26 OP 11,158 on existing-store -4.3%, showing DCM can hold Q2 profit on falling comps via cost control). Both come from the company, so they are not independent in the strict sense. Counter-evidence: Nafco's Apr-Jun OP fell 6.7% on sales up 0.8% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2790&b=k202608070351), a sign the June payback hurt home-center margins.

baseline_tension: Agrees with the flat baseline. Run-up (-2.2% 20d) and priced_lean (+0.12) are neutral, and my finding is a small positive that the public monthly series has largely pre-empted. The price already holds most of it.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: researcher_japan/LESSONS.md holds no resolved rules. Its open question 2 (whether 月次 pre-empt the print) was already the reason the draft sized the finding at +0.5 and the move at +0.3, so no re-size was needed
